features.featureTitle: Add a payment gate screen to the frontend. When an authenticated user is not yet activated, show a dedicated full-screen payment gate (instead of the normal dashboard) that displays: (1) a clear message that a one-time fee of 1 ICP is required, (2) the owner's ICP wallet address fetched from the backend, (3) a copyable address field for easy transfer, and (4) instructions to send exactly 1 ICP and then wait for manual confirmation. The gate should re-check activation status periodically so access is granted automatically once the owner activates the account.

Integrate the activation check into the existing ProfileOnboardingGate and App-level auth flow so that the payment gate is consistently enforced across the entire app. Non-activated users must not be able to navigate to any dashboard panel.
